stage_objective: Perform the final evidence-based acceptance of WebGPT-as-Codex against the repository SoT and original project goals without adding features: reconcile Stage 0-12 closures, verify the release artifact and representative safe runtime surfaces, confirm there are no unresolved release/security/ownership contradictions, run the final full gates, write the final acceptance closure, commit it, and hand off a fresh PROJECT-COMPLETE prompt from the verified final HEAD.
required_outputs: reconcile the original project goals and Stage 0-12 closure evidence, listing any contradiction or unresolved acceptance blocker rather than assuming prior closure is sufficient
verify the built release artifact from an isolated install, including metadata, console entry point, public runtime resources and representative safe CLI/Manager surfaces
run the final full repository tests, Ruff, secret scan, git diff/status and public-safe tracked-file checks
confirm lifecycle, OAuth/edge, generic Add MCP, Loop Engineering, exactly-once handoff and Stage 11 hardening ownership boundaries still match the final documentation
update only final acceptance/current-state/decision/experience records required by actual evidence and write the Final Overall Acceptance closure
commit Final Overall Acceptance, generate PROJECT-COMPLETE from the new verified HEAD, validate/hash it, Playwright-submit exactly once and verify sent-message + /c/ + new assistant run
do_not_redo: Stages 0-12 implementation unless contradictory final evidence identifies a minimum release-blocking boundary
new features, architecture redesigns or speculative cleanup during acceptance
machine-local OAuth/Tailscale credentials, browser profiles, private endpoints or unrelated repositories
treating process/listener/import success as a substitute for the deeper acceptance evidence required by the relevant boundary
known_risks: Final acceptance can expose contradictions between source-tree tests and installed-artifact behavior; reopen only the minimum affected release boundary if that happens.
Machine/session health for external MCPs may drift independently of repository correctness; distinguish transient harness evidence from product defects.
The final recursive handoff remains an exactly-once external side effect and is complete only after sent-message, /c/ URL and new-assistant-run verification.
